proposals.issue_title: Silent Image API Failures and Missing Fallbacks
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines hardcode specific image providers (like Pollinations or Gemini). When Gemini hits a 429 or Pollinations outputs low quality, the pipeline either crashes or produces unsellable assets, wasting valuable GitHub Actions runner cycles.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a unified `image_factory.py` wrapper. Implement a strict, prioritized fallback array: Together AI (FLUX-schnell) -> Cloudflare Workers AI -> Runware (if wallet > 0) -> Pollinations (as absolute emergency fallback). Include automatic retry decorators with exponential backoff on HTTP 429/502 errors.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero failed workflow runs, 100% automated resilience against API outages, consistent image generation quality.

proposals.current_pain_description: AI-generated coloring pages often contain broken lines, grey shading (unsuitable for coloring), or anatomical gibberish. Currently, these are saved as-is, requiring manual review from Hugo on a tiny mobile screen.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate `agent_gemini_quality_check` directly into the generation loop using Gemini 2.5 Flash (which is fast, free, and multimodal). Pass the generated image to Gemini with a strict checklist prompt (e.g., 'Is this pure black and white line art? Are there anatomical anomalies?'). If it fails, regenerate with a new seed (up to 3 attempts) before saving.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of unusable coloring pages automatically before Hugo ever sees them, preserving high-quality standards.

proposals.issue_title: Mobile Download and Upload Staging Bottleneck
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates solely from an Android phone (Termux). Navigating GitHub's desktop-heavy UI to download ZIP artifacts from GitHub Actions runs, extract them, and organize them for upload is a high-friction manual process.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a final step in GitHub Actions that pushes ready-to-publish assets (optimized ZIPs, metadata CSVs) to a dedicated `publish-staging` branch or creates a draft GitHub Release. Hugo can then download files with a single tap from a simplified mobile-friendly index page or direct Release link.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 15-20 minutes per batch upload; reduces friction of managing files on Android.

proposals.issue_title: Git Push Conflicts from GHA State Updates
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions workflows write back state changes (like updating `agent_brain_meta.json`) directly to the `main` branch. If Hugo is writing code on Termux simultaneously, his next push will be rejected, forcing complex git rebasing on a mobile terminal.
proposals.proposed_fix: Decouple state tracking from the main codebase. Store execution states, active priorities, and asset metadata in a free Cloudflare KV store, a lightweight external JSON bin (e.g., jsonbin.io), or a separate, orphaned Git branch (e.g., `state-db`) that is never merged into `main`.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents git merge/push conflicts on Termux, keeping Hugo's coding workflow fast and error-free.

proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines run in silos. A high-quality graphic generated for a coloring book or SVG pack is only used once, missing out on zero-marginal-cost revenue channels on other platforms.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a downstream orchestrator workflow `agent_cross_pollinator.py`. When a high-quality asset is generated and approved, it automatically generates: 1) A transparent PNG for Redbubble stickers, 2) A vector SVG for Etsy, 3) A compiled PDF page for KDP. All assets are packaged together with platform-specific meta tags.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Triples the surface area of every high-quality design across Redbubble, KDP, and Cults3D with zero extra design effort.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Real-Time Pipeline Status Notifications
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo must manually poll GitHub Actions on his phone's browser to see if a long-running book generation job succeeded, failed, or ran out of API limits.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight, free notification step at the end of GitHub Actions workflows using a Telegram Bot API or Discord Webhook. Send a direct message to Hugo's phone with: Workflow Name, Status (Success/Fail), Error Message (if failed), and direct staging download link.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Immediate feedback loop on mobile; eliminates manual status polling.
